content: Laravel 13.x queues (framework v13.37.0, 2026-10-16): --timeout (default 60) must be several seconds shorter than retry_after or jobs run twice; use --max-jobs/--max-time with Supervisor to recycle memory; --memory default 128MB; queue:restart on deploy uses cache for signal; queue:prune-failed default 24h; ShouldBeUnique needs atomic-lock cache; WithoutOverlapping middleware for concurrency.
